en.headline: 310 own commits across nine repos, plus skill, sandbox and toolkit releases
en.teaser: A month of building OpenCode skills and tooling: three skill-management releases, three model-picker releases, two pixel-logo releases, and a new sandbox repo.
en.overview:
The window ran 2026-10-23 to 2026-11-21 with no missing days. Totals were 310 own commits, 1 pull request action, 8 issue actions and 0 reviews, alongside 619 automated commits, all of them in the profile repository.

### OpenCode skills and tooling

Most of the work went into OpenCode-adjacent projects. `opencode-skill-management` shipped three releases (v1.0.0, v1.1.0, v1.2.0): the first stable surface, a switch to a single JSON object result with an output schema, and fixes for false divergence warnings and frontmatter boolean handling. It also gained an Astro + Starlight bilingual docs site deployed through GitHub Actions. `opencode-go-model-picker` shipped v2.0.0, v3.0.0 and v3.0.1, moving to priced accounting with Console calibration, then cutting the skill text by roughly 12.6x, then enforcing the candidate menu and per-source chains. `opencode-agent-sandbox` was the busiest repo by commits, mostly knowledge-base notes on VS Code, SenseNova and BYOK boundaries, plus a tightened AGENTS.md and an opened pull request.

### Other own repositories

`sopen-translate` got a UI redesign, NVIDIA presets with the Riva protocol, a local debug log backend and async review with id-based patches and undo, and adopted Apache-2.0. `pixel-logo-toolkit` released v0.2.0 and v0.3.0 with automatic text wrapping, overflow protection, a bilingual CLI and a 40-image command gallery. `dsh-openchamber-plugins` ported OpenChamber features as DSH plugins and added hidden-files and project skills. `dsh-ecosystem-report` got mobile viewport fixes, a single-button theme menu and a plugin list update. `myBlog` received two documentation commits with screenshots.

### Upstream issue work

Outside own repositories, issue actions went to `openchamber/openchamber` (six), `microsoft/PowerToys` (one) and `anomalyco/opencode` (one). Reported items covered a missing Console MCP server in settings, a stale session retention hint, a quote-card arrow that does nothing outside loaded history, unreliable line-number drag commenting, and a PowerToys Shortcut Guide NullReferenceException.

highlights.text: v1.0.0 froze the skill switchboard surface for 1.x, writing a single skill permission rule instead of touching skill files.
v1.1.0 made all four actions return one JSON object with an output schema, a breaking change.
v3.0.0 cut the skill text from 104,181 to 8,291 characters and consolidated nine runtime scripts into one entry point.
v0.3.0 added automatic line wrapping, proportional font step-down on overflow, and a full CLI manual.
Opened pull request #1 in the sandbox repository.
Opened a bug report that Settings > MCP omits the Console MCP server OpenCode adds at runtime.
Opened a Shortcut Guide bug about Hold-Win activation throwing NullReferenceException.
Commented on the feature request about running the bundled CLI on Windows desktop.

byRepo.text: 84 own commits and no automated commits, 1 pull request action, 0 issue actions, 0 reviews, 0 releases. Work was knowledge-base documentation: VS Code extensions, keybindings and Copilot/BYOK notes, SenseNova image skill notes with a Windows-without-WSL2 correction, an Iceman pelican eval entry, and a tightened AGENTS.md covering branch discipline and push proxies.

53 own commits and no automated commits, 0 pull request actions, 0 issue actions, 0 reviews, 3 releases. Built an Astro + Starlight bilingual docs site with GitHub Actions Pages deployment, fixed theme persistence and mobile layout, documented the release policy, and shipped v1.0.0, v1.1.0 and v1.2.0.

50 own commits plus 619 automated commits, 0 pull request actions, 0 issue actions, 0 reviews, 0 releases. Added built-in CLI help, decoupled the provider chain into `config/providers.json`, wired Nvidia into the daily report chain, fixed fallback directory lanes, and retired the minimax and longcat free providers.

46 own commits and no automated commits, 0 pull request actions, 0 issue actions, 0 reviews, 0 releases. Redesigned options and popup with a shared theme, added NVIDIA presets and the Riva protocol, added a local debug log backend, implemented async review with id-based patches and undo, and adopted Apache-2.0 with a merged NOTICE.

29 own commits and no automated commits, 0 pull request actions, 0 issue actions, 0 reviews, 2 releases. Added text auto-wrapping and overflow protection, made query-only commands work without Pillow, made the CLI bilingual, switched Korean to the Galmuri font, and shipped v0.2.0 and v0.3.0 with a 40-image example gallery.

20 own commits and no automated commits, 0 pull request actions, 0 issue actions, 0 reviews, 3 releases. Delivered priced accounting with Console calibration and output v2, stopped recalibration from restamping old bias dates, moved test prompts into tests/, and shipped v2.0.0, v3.0.0 and v3.0.1.

15 own commits and no automated commits, 0 pull request actions, 0 issue actions, 0 reviews, 0 releases. Ported OpenChamber features as DSH plugins, archived ported skills, added a hidden-files toggle plus `/init` and zh-doc-sync skills, and wrote Chinese README and AGENTS translations with porting rules.

11 own commits and no automated commits, 0 pull request actions, 0 issue actions, 0 reviews, 0 releases. Fixed mobile table and 375/414 viewport layout, replaced the theme control with a single button and popup menu, refined the visual styling, merged three plugins into the resource list, and added a GitHub repo button plus LICENSE.

0 own commits, 0 automated commits, 0 pull request actions, 6 issue actions, 0 reviews, 0 releases. Opened bug reports on the missing Console MCP server, the stale session retention hint, the silent quote-card arrow and unreliable line-number drag commenting, and started two idea discussions on Files view commenting and the VS Code extension fallback.

2 own commits and no automated commits, 0 pull request actions, 0 issue actions, 0 reviews, 0 releases. Added an OpenChamber session retention hint screenshot and screenshots of the DSH stats show-context-delta bug.
0 own commits, 0 automated commits, 0 pull request actions, 1 issue action, 0 reviews, 0 releases. Commented on the feature request that the Windows desktop app ships the CLI without a way to run it.

zh.headline: 九个仓库共 310 次本人提交，另有技能、沙箱与工具包发布
zh.teaser: 这个月主要在做 OpenCode 相关技能与工具：技能管理三次发版、模型选择器三次发版、像素 Logo 工具两次发版，并新建了沙箱仓库。
zh.overview:
本窗口为 2026-10-23 至 2026-11-21，没有缺失日期。总计 310 次本人提交、1 次拉取请求操作、8 次 issue 互动（新开、关闭或评论）、0 次评审，另有 619 次自动提交，全部集中在个人主页仓库。

### OpenCode 技能与工具

大部分工作集中在 OpenCode 相关项目。`opencode-skill-management` 发布了 v1.0.0、v1.1.0、v1.2.0 三个版本：先是冻结 1.x 的稳定接口，随后改为返回单个 JSON 对象并声明输出 schema，再修复了跨 agent 差异误报和 frontmatter 布尔值处理问题；同时新增 Astro + Starlight 双语文档站，通过 GitHub Actions 部署。`opencode-go-model-picker` 发布 v2.0.0、v3.0.0、v3.0.1，依次完成带定价的核算与 Console 校准、把技能文本压缩约 12.6 倍、强制候选菜单与按来源分链。`opencode-agent-sandbox` 提交数最多，内容以知识库笔记为主，涉及 VS Code、SenseNova 与 BYOK 边界，并收紧了 AGENTS.md、开了一个拉取请求。

### 其他自有仓库

`sopen-translate` 重做了选项页与弹窗主题，加入 NVIDIA 预设与 Riva 协议、本地调试日志后端，以及基于 id 补丁和撤销的异步评审，并改用 Apache-2.0 许可。`pixel-logo-toolkit` 发布 v0.2.0 与 v0.3.0，带来文本自动折行、溢出保护、中英双语命令行和 40 张示例画廊。`dsh-openchamber-plugins` 把 OpenChamber 功能移植为 DSH 插件，并加入隐藏文件开关与项目技能。`dsh-ecosystem-report` 修复移动端视口，改为单按钮主题菜单并更新插件清单。`myBlog` 有两次文档提交，补充截图。

### 上游 issue 工作

自有仓库之外，issue 互动分布在 `openchamber/openchamber`（6 次）、`microsoft/PowerToys`（1 次）和 `anomalyco/opencode`（1 次）。报告内容涉及设置页缺少 Console MCP 服务器、会话保留提示过时、引用卡片箭头在历史未加载时无反应、按行号拖拽评论不可靠，以及 PowerToys 快捷指南的空引用异常。

highlights.text: v1.0.0 冻结了技能开关的 1.x 接口，只写入一条 skill 权限规则，不改动技能文件。
v1.1.0 让四个动作统一返回单个 JSON 对象并声明输出 schema，属于破坏性变更。
v3.0.0 把技能文本从 104,181 字符压到 8,291 字符，九个运行时脚本合并为一个入口。
v0.3.0 加入自动折行、溢出时按比例缩小字号，并补齐完整命令行手册。
在沙箱仓库开了拉取请求 #1。
提交缺陷报告：设置页 MCP 缺少 OpenCode 运行时添加的 Console MCP 服务器。
提交快捷指南缺陷：按住 Win 激活时抛出空引用异常。
在关于 Windows 桌面版自带 CLI 却无法运行的功能请求下留言。
